calendarFaqs.q: Do all FWCS students have the same first attendance date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Kindergarten and grades 6 and 9 attend Transition Day on August 6. The districtwide first student day for K–12 students is August 12, and Pre-K begins August 26.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the October 30 FWCS conference date a school day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. FWCS designates Oct. 30, 2026, as a Release Day for parent-teacher conferences; students do not attend school that day.

calendarFaqs.q: Which FWCS dates may be used as make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar labels May 26 as a teacher work and make-up day and May 27–28 as reserve make-up days. Do not assume students attend on these dates unless FWCS announces that they will be used.

calendarFaqs.q: Why do some FWCS semester dates differ within the official PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: The semester headers show Dec. 17 and May 26, while the detailed quarter ranges and dated entries use Dec. 18 and May 25. May 26 is listed separately as a teacher work and make-up day, so this page follows the detailed dated entries.
